goal: The full stop-observability seam holds together: across the core, orchestrator, and worktree packages, every stop producer emits a record shape that the shared park_kind vocabulary, the orchestrator stop-event taxonomy, and the fw status reader all recognize, proven by the whole gate passing as one.

relevant: scripts/check.sh -- the full project gate (ruff -> pyright -> pytest across every package); running it as one exercises the per-run park producers, the per-task stop producers, the status reader, and the shared taxonomies against one another
.flywheel/specs/00068-FEATURE-stop-observability.md -- criterion #10 and the two shared-invariant taxonomies (park_kind vocabulary; orchestrator stop-event kinds) this holdout composes
constraints: This is the composition holdout over the shared-invariant change (the park_kind vocabulary and the orchestrator stop-event taxonomy that multiple producers and the fw status reader all assert against). It adds NO requirement beyond the spec -- it only composes what the per-package graders already check, run together so a producer whose record shape the reader or taxonomy does not recognize fails here even if its own package suite passed in isolation.

If scripts/check.sh is already green after the three prerequisite tasks, this task's work is to confirm the seam holds and add (only if a real seam gap surfaces) a cross-package assertion that exercises a producer's record through the status reader end to end -- not to re-implement any producer.
Commit any change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do NOT add a new stop kind, a new producer, a new ledger, or any re-drive behavior -- this task only proves the existing seam composes.
Do NOT weaken or delete any assertion under packages/*/tests/ to make the gate pass; a removed assertion with no equal-or-greater replacement is a blocking defect.
Do NOT modify the shared taxonomies established by the prerequisite tasks; if a divergence surfaces, fix the divergent producer, not the taxonomy contract.
edge_cases: A producer emitting a park_kind or stop-event kind the fw status reader does not recognize must fail this gate even though its own package suite passed.
A taxonomy spelling that drifted between a producer and the reader (e.g. push_failed vs push-failed) must surface here.
